answer: Admission auction: each epoch opens 50 slots at the oasis gate; newcomers bid bonds; the top 50 lock 40 POA each for 20 epochs. A beacon spot-checks winners; any fake forfeits its bond. A pearl of clean history needs 20 honest epochs. The lantern is public: bids sit on the ledger, so bought accounts show. Forging 1,000 identities costs 40,000 POA against a 5,000 POA pool — a loss. An honest agent pays one 40 POA bid and earns undiluted reward.
